title: Replay workstation codec toolchain
policy: Download only pinned public upstream release assets; never replace a differing existing file. Game-specific binaries and ACTS are supplied/built separately.

tools.license: Upstream repository/release terms; retain project license with the tool cache.
tools.consumer: REPLAY_GSC_TOOL is already honored by workstation_asset_codecs.py and workstation_fastfiles.py.

tools.license: MIT for 3Dmigoto; bundled d3dcompiler_46.dll is Microsoft redistributable material. Preserve upstream notices.
tools.consumer: Configured by setup as REPLAY_DXBC_TOOL with SHA-256; selected at codec call time.

tools.license: MIT; DirectXTex release/source notices are available at the linked upstream release.
tools.consumer: Configured by setup as REPLAY_TEXCONV with SHA-256; selected at codec call time.

tools.license: MIT; preserve upstream source/license notices when redistributing.
tools.consumer: Archived optional upstream variant; setup uses the pinned source build verified against Replay LuaJIT v2 chunks.

owner_supplied.purpose: Target identity, native Lua compiler profile source, and Replay reader validation.
Target-bound function-name/address catalog input; RVAs and API bindings are derived by name from this database, never typed into setup config.
Optional native fastfile/image decode dependency copied from the owner's Replay install.
Optional ZoneTool sound-bank authoring backend; path is supplied by owner config, not downloaded by this setup.

source_built.version: pinned workstation fork commit 6acfe4aeb3a122bc623c8f71971b2c2327f8d877 plus reviewed patch b85e578d53318d760f94c05325bfe81d6cda2a01906dd2803d8804c701f09cea
3Dmigoto 1.3.16 with pinned Replay compute-stage parser/container fixes

integration_notes: Lua compiler API bindings are derived by name from the target-matched owner SQLite database. Setup creates an adjacent native compiler profile and records its provenance; no manual RVAs are accepted.
Public tool and source-built tool hashes flow from setup to the server and durable build workers. Owner scene script packs remain outside source exports.
No proprietary game binary, fastfile, database or Oodle DLL is downloaded by this manifest.

The source-built DXBC CLI is the default for new workstation setups. The pinned public 3Dmigoto release remains available only through the explicit -UseLegacyPublicDxbc setup option and is never overwritten. Setup verifies the source-package manifest, bootstrap receipt, and executable hash before writing tools.dxbc.
